items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I forget his name. ... Light fella, saxophone player. He stayed in there.

ctx.x: Well he was later. That was the ending of the Apollo Theater. He stayed in there for a long while. I forget his name.
He died in Hawaii (inaudible) on the road some place. Light fella, saxophone player. He stayed in there.
